6079.title: Host updater rejects successful installs when npm wrappers fail
6079.rootCauseOneLine: The daemon executes an npm shell launcher whose missing post-install helper returns 127 after npm has installed the package, so the updater reports failure and skips restart.
6079.proposedFix: Invoke the npm CLI belonging to the running Node directly with process.execPath; retain the PATH fallback when no sibling npm CLI exists.
6079.caveats: Generated missing-helper wrapper and real npm on Linux; no historical mise or native macOS run. The regression test is inline. Two unrelated broad-suite failures also reproduce on unchanged main.
